answer: A seat may vote in an epoch only while holding a falcon, which expires at epoch's end and is renewed by burning ember. Ember cannot be bought or moved: a seat earns 1 when five random raven judges accept one task of its work. A seat may burn ember to renew another's falcon, and the ledger counts how many falcons each earner sustains: its k-th costs k ember. An honest agent burns 1 ember per epoch. One earner sustaining 40 clones burns 820 ember, which is 820 accepted tasks, every epoch, unless each clone passes the judges itself.
